meta.inspection: All 25 images individually opened using view_image; prior exact anchors preserved by own-image hashes. No key, source or other judges inspected.
meta.blinding_limitations: Repeated controls and visual families recognizable. Sci-fi resembles StarCraft and battlefields Company of Heroes; tactical reference uncertain.

view-01.png.evidence: Cyan player ring remains easy to locate; runway, shaded roofs/trees and dark ocean retain prior structure. Thin pale broken shore strokes are visible beyond the beach.
view-01.png.visible_regressions_or_limitations: Shore strokes read as narrow dashed lines at a nearly constant offset from beach, rather than irregular connected foam. Broad blue shallows remain too uniform; angular beach transitions persist. No material naturalness improvement sufficient to change scores. Player material still merges with roof where overlapping; ring supplies location only.

general_next_priorities: Use directional light and distinct top/rim/side values on carrier; a pale uniform outline reduces volume.
Turn dashed offshore rails into irregular foam patches tied to beach geometry.
Retain terrain clustering but replace uniform grass noise and heavy circular contact shadows with grounded relief/material variation.
Resolve aircraft/deck overlap and blue aircraft/hangar contrast inside useful locator ring.
Give major impacts visual priority over equal sparks and remove repetitive smoke/wake stamps.
